# Rafiq v0.5.10: smarter design, and motion that shows what's going on

Sites stop looking alike, you talk to a design part by part, and the whole app now shows
what it's doing while it works. A one-minute video of everything is attached
(`whats-new-en.mp4`, also in Arabic and Russian).

---

## 🎨 Design

- **Every site gets its own character:** each new design gets one of 13 art directions (a
  run of posters, a living bento, a split screen, a manifesto in words, a horizontal
  gallery…), picked so it differs from your recent designs. The model is told how to
  compose the page in it, not just which colours to use.
- **3 variants:** one button asks for three versions of the page, each in a different
  direction. They show side by side, any one can be enlarged, and «Keep this one» makes it
  the page (and its direction the design's).
- **Pick parts and say what to change:** click several parts of a page or of an app's
  screens; each gets a number on the design and its own note in a small composer, and they
  all go to the model in one message with each part's selector and HTML. Pointing at a note
  scrolls to its part and pulses it.
- **Undo under every design reply:** takes every document the reply changed back to its
  previous version; the notification has «Redo». Nothing is deleted: every version stays in
  the Versions tab.
- **Before & after:** the old and new versions one over the other, with a handle to drag
  across them; both pages scroll together.
- **The page builds while it's written:** instead of a blank wait, the preview shows each
  part (header, sections, footer) as it arrives, the one being written shimmering.
- The preview frame springs between phone, tablet and desktop widths instead of jumping.

## 💬 Chat

- **What it's doing, at a glance:** the status line's icon follows the kind of work
  (reading, writing, running, the web, waiting for you), with a count of finished steps.
- **Tool cards:** a small pill while a step runs, a card with its result when it lands, and
  a result that went fine folds away once the next step starts (a failure stays open).
- **Risky commands take a long press:** deleting files, killing a process, pushing to git,
  posting to a team channel, and commands like `rm`, `del`, `Remove-Item`,
  `git push --force` or `git reset --hard` are allowed with a press-and-hold, so a stray
  click allows nothing.
- **Context ring:** beside the model, how full its window is after a reply (amber past 70%,
  red past 90%); a click summarizes the older messages to make room.
- **Your message flies** from the box to its place in the chat, and lands once.
- **Done while you were away:** a Windows notification and a flashing taskbar button when a
  reply or a design finishes while you're in another window.
- When a file is written with the side panel closed, its name slides into the panel's button.

## ✨ Across the app

- Notifications with an action (like «Redo») show how long they'll wait, and pause with it.
- Copy buttons turn into a check that draws itself.
- More switches slide between their options.

## 🔧 Fixed

- A two-finger touchpad drag could pull the whole window aside and show black behind it.
- On the phone board, scrolling with the mouse selected text; dragging now scrolls the screen
  (or moves the board where a screen doesn't scroll), and clicks still work.

---

**Updating:** installed copies offer this update on their own. For a new install, download
`Rafiq_0.5.10_x64-setup.exe` below and check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.5.10_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```
